| Number of Employees by Score and Session | $5$ out of $5$ | $4$ out of $5$ | $3$ out of $5$ | $2$ out of $5$ | $1$ out of $5$ | $0$ out of $5$ | Total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Session $1$ | $4$ | $2$ | $6$ | $5$ | $3$ | $5$ | $25$ |
| Session $2$ | $2$ | $5$ | $4$ | $6$ | $6$ | $2$ | $25$ |
| Session $3$ | $3$ | $3$ | $5$ | $4$ | $4$ | $6$ | $25$ |
| **Total** | **$9$** | **$10$** | **$15$** | **$15$** | **$13$** | **$13$** | **$75$** |

No employee received the same score on two different days. If an employee is selected at random, what is the probability that the selected employee received a score of $5$ on Session $1$ or Session $3$, given that the employee received a score of $5$ on one of the three sessions?
